title: Variance timestamps
description: The four timestamps that decompose Variance Duration into FAIR-CAM segments, so you can see which function is slow: started to detected is Control Monitoring, detected to remediation_started is Treatment Selection and Prioritisation, remediation_started to completed is Implementation. This is the piece almost nobody emits and it is the whole point.

started_at_basis.description: How variance_started_at was established, in descending order of quality. source_system is the source's own change timestamp - cloud config item capture, IdP event log, Git commit. interpolated bounds it to the collection interval. equals_detected systematically understates Variance Duration and overstates reliability, so it must be declared rather than inferred: every artifact reporting a duration derived from it says so, and treats the resulting reliability as an upper bound.
